{{short description|French mathematician}}
{{Expand French|topic=bio|Alexandre Savérien|date=April 2012}}

[[File:Savérien - Histoire critique du calcul des infiniment-petits, contenant la métaphysique et la théorie de ce calcul, 1753 - 4685663.tif|thumb|''Histoire critique du calcul des infiniment-petits'', 1753]]
'''Alexandre Julien Savérien''' (16 July 1720 – 3 May 1805) was a French mathematician who was also an expert in several other subject areas. He was born in [[Arles]] and became accomplished in both mathematics and naval engineering at a young age.<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last1=Piaia |first1=Gregorio |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=FfprCgAAQBAJ |title=Models of the History of Philosophy: Vol. III: The Second Enlightenment and the Kantian Age |last2=Santinello |first2=Giovanni |date=2015-08-24 |publisher=Springer |isbn=978-94-017-9966-9 |pages=98–115 |language=en}}</ref> in 1754, he published the ''Universal Dictionary of Mathematics and Physics'' and ''[[Histoire des philosophes modernes]]'' in 1773, where he named the nine greatest modern philosophers as [[Jakob Abbadie]], [[Erasmus]], [[Thomas Hobbes]], Nicole, [[John Locke]], [[Baruch Spinoza]], [[Nicolas Malebranche]], Bayle, Clarke, and Collins.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Holland |first=Jocelyn |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nwGPDwAAQBAJ |title=The Lever as Instrument of Reason: Technological Constructions of Knowledge around 1800 |date=2019-05-30 |publisher=Bloomsbury Publishing USA |isbn=978-1-5013-4607-1 |pages=20 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nakhimovsky |first=Isaac |date=January 2003 |title=The Enlightened Epicureanism of Jacques Abbadie: L'Art de se connoı^tre soi-même and the morality of self-interest |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1016/S0191-6599%2802%2900092-X |journal=History of European Ideas |language=en |volume=29 |issue=1 |pages=1–14 |doi=10.1016/S0191-6599(02)00092-X |s2cid=171058718 |issn=0191-6599|url-access=subscription }}</ref> He later became a member of the [[Academy of Lyon]].<ref name=":0" />
